shot1: The first shot establishes the environment at the beginning, using a wide shot with eye-level perspective, starting from one side of the main hall and panning while slowly moving forward. In the foreground are slightly blurred candle holders and stone columns; in the midground, the girl choir wearing deep blue cloaks stands in neat rows; in the background, towering vaulted ceilings, hanging banners, and the depth toward the throne are visible. Composition uses leading lines from the stone floor to draw the viewer's gaze to the center of the formation. Warm candlelight creates soft highlights along the edges of the cloaks, while cool-colored patches from stained glass scatter across the floor and walls.
shot2: The second shot transitions from the previous shot via a hard cut, shifting to a close-up in the stained-glass corridor with a slightly low eye-level angle. She is positioned slightly forward in the frame, with multiple rows of choir members extending into the distance along the corridor’s vanishing point, creating clear foreground-background layering. Brighter red, blue, and gold fragments of light from the stained glass fall across the scene, while warm candlelight continues to unify the visual texture. The other girls inhale, open their mouths, and respond almost simultaneously. Slight movement of cloak hems accompanies the motion.
shot3: The entire choir is centered on the platform, with the throne and a large tapestry behind forming a stable backdrop. The focal point is the front row standing upright and proud, with the rear rows arranged symmetrically. Focus covers the faces and upper bodies of the first two rows, while the background is slightly blurred but still reveals the edge of the platform and stone railings. Lighting remains dominated by warm candlelight, supplemented by faint cool top-lighting, enhancing the three-dimensionality of the deep blue cloaks and facial contours. As the final section begins, the entire group simultaneously lifts their chins, straightens their spines, and opens their chests, creating a unified upward gesture in the upward-facing shot. The final note ends crisply in the last second, with everyone closing their mouths and stabilizing their bodies, leaving a brief and clean echo in the cathedral space.
